author: LGR
description:
Opening a boxed and unused* N64 that launched in 1996! Nintendo released the system three decades ago now, so its 30th anniversary in 2026 is an ideal time to unbox a 1997 model, ogle those SGI chips, set it all up with a vintage CRT TV, and play some games with that delightfully odd controller.

* 'unused' not guaranteed due to eBayers sketchily repackaging things
